subtitle: Private video editing
googleShortDescription: Upload, correct subtitles, edit and preview videos in your private Studio.
description:
Your videos. Your private Studio.

LazyEdit Studio gives invited members a private video-editing workspace at edit.lazying.art. An invitation and internet connection are required. Sign in with your Studio account; your videos and settings stay separate from other members.

Upload a video, add background context to help correct speech-recognition mistakes, and keep the actual spoken content and timing. Choose subtitle languages, pronunciation guides, grammar colors, font size, placement, logo and portrait background layout. Process the video, preview the edited result, and review its cover and metadata. Social accounts are not needed for editing or preview.

Social publication is a separate, optional integration enabled by the service operator for approved accounts. An enabled account connects its own platform sessions and explicitly submits a publication task. It does not share the operator's channels, Pi or private media. Publishing access is not included in the processing subscriptions.

Native library, upload, editing configuration, activity and account screens support English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Arabic, French, Spanish, German and Russian. The detailed Studio editor is available inside the app.

Members can delete their account and private workspace from Account after active work finishes. The authorized Vancouver sample lets invited members try the editor without another person's private library.

The current release requires an invitation and has bounded processing capacity. Monthly subscriptions are being prepared and are not offered in this pilot.

Privacy and support: https://edit.lazying.art/privacy

reviewAccess.notes: Use the separately supplied private reviewer Studio account. This account has the same editing capabilities as ordinary invited members: its own Vancouver sample, upload, subtitle correction, layout, processing, cover/metadata and preview. No social account is needed for these functions. Publication is an explicitly documented operator-enabled integration, disabled for ordinary members and this account. Do not request the operator's Pi, media or channel credentials. Disclose this capability distinction to review; do not certify access to all publication features solely on the basis of editor access.
